steps: Parked existing StarterPack tools (Spear, Dagger) into ServerStorage
generate_mesh a medieval falchion (broad single-edged cleaver blade widening to tip, crossguard, wrapped grip, round pommel)
Captured to confirm distinct falchion silhouette at ~4-stud hand scale
save_mesh to make the mesh+texture durable (survives Play)
make_tool with the mesh as Handle, moved Tool into StarterPack
bind_behavior fast swing (windup 0.1 / active 0.12 / cooldown 0.3), then bind_hitbox (damage 28, reach 7, cooldown 0.3)

recipe.text: Fresh concept: a falchion — a broad, forward-widening single-edged cleaver-blade sword, distinct from prior straight swords/dagger/spear. Cube-generated + saved durable, toolified with hilt Handle. Fast swing timings (0.1/0.12/0.3) with moderate 28 damage over a short 7-stud reach and 0.3s server-authoritative cooldown.
